name: recurse
description: Discover and call hosted tools through Recurse. Inspect current schemas and prices, set a spending cap, and retrieve stored results.

interface.longDescription: Find current tools in the Recurse catalog, inspect their schemas and prices, and call them with exact versions and an explicit spending cap. Read stored results and request cancellation through five stable MCP operations. Requires the Tools-capable Recurse SDK and a Recurse account.
defaultPrompt: Find a Recurse tool for my task and inspect its inputs and price.
Call an inspected Recurse tool within my spending allowance.
Check the stored result and charge for my Recurse call.
